detailZones.title: Left seating area
detailZones.description: Inspect the dining tables, moulded chairs, frames, legs, feet, tabletop edges and clear circulation space.

detailZones.title: Serving counter
detailZones.description: Explore the serving counter, tray slide, sneeze guard, food pans, crockery, chilled case and service fittings.

detailZones.title: Drinks and daylight wall
detailZones.description: Inspect the windows, radiator, planting, drinks dispenser, cups, tray rack, clock and wall panels.

detailZones.title: Queue and payment route
detailZones.description: Follow the queue stanchions, retractable belts, payment pedestal and open tiled approach to the counter.

detailZones.title: Kitchen doorway
detailZones.description: Inspect the complete kitchen doorway and the ovens, worktables, sinks, shelving and service route visible beyond it.

detailZones.title: Self-clearing station
detailZones.description: Explore the self-clearing counter, bottle station, crockery shelves, waste containers, planting and nearby table.

anchorAudit.rationale: The generated source and final JPEG were inspected at native and final pixels. This scene retains 150 independently pointable objects and visible parts across 6 bounded zones. People, identity, readable text, brands, hidden contents, inferred processes and unsupported states were excluded.
